  const section = document.getElementById('linear-edit-section');
  if (!section) return;
  section.style.display = '';
  const status = document.getElementById('linear-edit-status');
  if (status) status.textContent = 'Loading…';
  if (!preserveExistingDraft) {
    document.getElementById('linear-edit-title').value = '';
    document.getElementById('linear-edit-desc').value = '';
    document.getElementById('linear-edit-state').innerHTML = '';
    _detailPreferredAgent = 'claude';
    document.getElementById('linear-edit-agent-claude')?.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('linear-edit-agent-codex')?.classList.remove('active');
    _setLinearEditDisabled(true);
  }
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/linear/issues/${linear_issue_id}`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('not found');
    const issue = await res.json();
    if (requestSeq !== _detailLinearLoadSeq || _detailLinearIssueId !== linear_issue_id || !_isModalOpen('detail-modal')) return;
    _detailLinearUpdatedAt = issue.updated_at || '';

    // Populate state dropdown
    _detailLinearStates = issue.team_states || [];
    const stateEl = document.getElementById('linear-edit-state');
    stateEl.innerHTML = '';
    _detailLinearStates.forEach(s => {
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = s.name;
      opt.textContent = s.name;
      if (s.name === issue.state) opt.selected = true;
      stateEl.appendChild(opt);
    });
    const draft = preserveExistingDraft ? currentDraft : _restoreLinearDraft(issue);
    if (_linearStateToBoard(issue.state) === 'in_review') {
      if (_detailReplyDirty()) {
        _saveReplyDraft();
      } else {
        _restoreReplyDraft();
      }
    } else {
      _clearReplyDraftForIssue(linear_issue_id);

    if (preserveExistingDraft) {
      document.getElementById('linear-edit-title').value = currentDraft.title;
      document.getElementById('linear-edit-desc').value = currentDraft.description;
      setDetailIssueAgent(currentDraft.preferred_agent || issue.preferred_agent || 'claude');

    if (draft.state) stateEl.value = draft.state;
    _detailLinearInitial = {
      title: issue.title || '',
      description: issue.description || '',

      link.textContent = '↗ ' + (issue.identifier || 'Open in Linear');

    if (status) status.textContent = 'Failed to load issue';

  }

// ── Voice input (Web Speech API) ────────────────────────────────────────────
let _micRecognition = null;
let _micTargetId = null;
let _micBtnId = null;
let _micStatusId = null;

function _normalizeSpeechSegment(text, { final = false } = {}) {
  const raw = String(text || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return '';

  if (!final) return raw;
  if (/[。！？!?．.!…~～]$/.test(raw)) return raw;

  const questionLike = /(吗|么|呢|吧|是不是|对不对|好不好|行不行|可不可以|能不能|要不要)$/;
  return `${raw}${questionLike.test(raw) ? '？' : '。'}`;
}

function _appendSpeechSegment(baseText, segment, { final = false } = {}) {
  const chunk = _normalizeSpeechSegment(segment, { final });
  if (!chunk) return baseText || '';
  return `${baseText || ''}${chunk}`;
}

function toggleMic() {
  toggleMicFor('detail-reply-input', 'mic-btn', 'mic-status');
}

function toggleMicFor(targetId, btnId, statusId) {
  if (_micRecognition) {
    _stopMic();
    // If same button clicked again while active, just stop
    if (_micBtnId === btnId) return;
  }
  _startMic(targetId, btnId, statusId);
}

function _startMic(targetId, btnId, statusId) {
  const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
  const stEl = document.getElementById(statusId);
  if (!SR) {
    if (stEl) { stEl.style.display = ''; stEl.textContent = 'Speech API not supported'; }
    return;
  }
  _micTargetId = targetId;
  _micBtnId = btnId;
  _micStatusId = statusId;
  const rec = new SR();
  rec.continuous = true;
  rec.interimResults = true;
  rec.lang = 'zh-CN';
  _micRecognition = rec;
  let finalTranscript = (document.getElementById(targetId) || {}).value || '';

  rec.onstart = () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
    if (btn) { btn.style.color = 'var(--red)'; btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--red)'; btn.textContent = '⏹'; }
    if (stEl) { stEl.style.display = ''; stEl.textContent = '● Listening…'; stEl.style.color = 'var(--red)'; }
  };

  rec.onresult = (e) => {
    let interim = '';
    for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) {
      if (e.results[i].isFinal) {
        finalTranscript = _appendSpeechSegment(finalTranscript, e.results[i][0].transcript, { final: true });
      } else {
        interim = _appendSpeechSegment(interim, e.results[i][0].transcript);
      }
    }
    const ta = document.getElementById(targetId);
    if (ta) ta.value = finalTranscript + interim;
    if (stEl) stEl.textContent = interim ? `● ${interim}` : '● Listening…';
  };

  rec.onerror = (e) => {
    if (stEl) { stEl.textContent = `Mic error: ${e.error}`; stEl.style.color = 'var(--red)'; }
    _stopMic();
  };

  rec.onend = () => { _stopMic(); };
  rec.start();
}

function _stopMic() {
  if (_micRecognition) { try { _micRecognition.stop(); } catch (_) {} _micRecognition = null; }
  const btn = document.getElementById(_micBtnId);
  if (btn) { btn.style.color = ''; btn.style.borderColor = ''; btn.textContent = '🎙'; }
  const st = document.getElementById(_micStatusId);
  if (st) { st.style.display = 'none'; st.style.color = ''; }
  _micTargetId = _micBtnId = _micStatusId = null;
}

function _stateBadgeHtml(state) {
  const dot = state === 'running' ? '<span class="pulse-dot"></span>' : '';
  const labels = {
    running: 'Running', success: 'Done', failed: 'Failed', timeout: 'Timeout',
    sent: 'Sent', backlog: 'Backlog', error: 'Error', todo: 'Todo', rework: 'Rework',
    merging: 'Merging', cancelled: 'Canceled', duplicate: 'Duplicated',

function _buildCol(col, items) {
  const isTodo = col.key === 'todo';
  const colEl = document.createElement('div');
  colEl.className = 'job-col';
  colEl.dataset.colKey = col.key;
  const addBtn = isTodo
    ? `<button type="button" class="col-add-btn" onclick="openNewIssueModal()" title="New task">+</button>`
    : '';
  colEl.innerHTML = `
    <div class="job-col-header">
      <div class="job-col-dot ${col.dotClass}"></div>
      <span class="job-col-title">${col.label}</span>
      <span class="job-col-count">${items.length}</span>
      ${addBtn}
    </div>
    <div class="job-col-body"></div>
  `;
  const body = colEl.querySelector('.job-col-body');
  if (items.length === 0) {
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="job-col-empty">No items</div>';
  } else {
    items.slice(0, _colLimit).forEach(r => body.appendChild(_buildColCard(r)));
  }
  body.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
    const payload = _readBoardDragPayload(e);
    const canDropLinear = !!payload && payload.kind === 'linear_issue' && !!LINEAR_STATE_BY_COL_KEY[col.key];
    const canDropRun = !!payload && payload.kind === 'run' && col.droppable;
    if (!canDropLinear && !canDropRun) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
    body.classList.add('drag-over');
  });
  body.addEventListener('dragleave', () => { body.classList.remove('drag-over'); });
  body.addEventListener('drop', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    body.classList.remove('drag-over');
    const payload = _readBoardDragPayload(e);
    if (!payload) return;
    if (payload.kind === 'linear_issue' && LINEAR_STATE_BY_COL_KEY[col.key]) {
      await _moveLinearIssueToColumn(payload.issue_id, LINEAR_STATE_BY_COL_KEY[col.key]);
      return;

    if (payload.kind === 'run' && col.droppable) {

        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },

      });
      refreshJobBoard();
    }
  });
  return colEl;
}

  const raw = e.dataTransfer.getData('application/x-agenticos-board-item')
    || e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
  if (!raw) return null;

  try {

  return { kind: 'run', run_id: raw };

function _normalizeErrorText(raw) {
  const text = String(raw || '').trim();
  if (!text) return '';
  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
  const noiseLine = /^(OpenAI Codex v\d|--------|workdir:|model:|provider:|approval:|sandbox:|reasoning effort:|reasoning summaries:|session id:|user$|codex$|exec$|succeeded in|succeeded$|succeeded with|tokens used$)/i;
  const realLine = /(^|\b)(Traceback \(most recent call last\)|SyntaxError:|ReferenceError:|TypeError:|RangeError:|AssertionError:|Error:|Exception:|timed out after|timed out\b|Command '\[|Command ")/i;
  let start = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i += 1) {
    const line = lines[i].trim();
    if (!line || noiseLine.test(line)) continue;
    if (realLine.test(line)) {
      start = i;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (start < 0) return '';
  return lines.slice(start).join('\n').trim();
}

function openLatestError() {
  if (!errorRuns.length) return;

function _runTimeMs(run) {
  const raw = run.started_at || run.created_at || '';
  const ms = Date.parse(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(ms) ? ms : 0;
}

function _preferRun(candidate, current) {
  const candidateRunning = (candidate.status || candidate.state) === 'running';
  const currentRunning = (current.status || current.state) === 'running';
  if (candidateRunning !== currentRunning) return candidateRunning;
  const candidateAttempt = Number(candidate.attempt || 0);
  const currentAttempt = Number(current.attempt || 0);
  if (candidateAttempt !== currentAttempt) return candidateAttempt > currentAttempt;
  return _runTimeMs(candidate) >= _runTimeMs(current);
}

function _latestLinearRuns(items) {
  const unlinked = [];
  const byIssue = new Map();
  items.forEach(run => {
    const issueId = run.linear_issue_id;
    if (!issueId) {
      unlinked.push(run);
      return;
    }
    const current = byIssue.get(issueId);
    if (!current || _preferRun(run, current)) byIssue.set(issueId, run);
  });
  return unlinked.concat(Array.from(byIssue.values()));
}
